name: ThemeToggle
description:
Flips light<->dark via `useTheme`, which reads <html data-theme> on the
first render in the browser (and reports light during SSR/hydration,
then updates). The old "mounted" gate on top of that made the label and
icon say "light" for a frame on a dark page, so a click in that frame
switched to the theme that was already on.
whenToUse: A quick light/dark switch in the top bar.

whenNotToUse.text: When “same as system” must be a choice too
whenNotToUse.instead: a radio group in the account menu or settings

anatomy.description: sun / moon; flips `data-theme` on the document.

do.caption: One place, in the top bar, next to the other global controls.

dont.caption: Repeating a global setting on every page makes it look page-specific.
dont.example: A theme switch in every page header

a11y: Its name says the action — “Switch to dark theme” / “Switch to light theme” — so it also tells which theme is on now.
Keyboard: a regular button, Enter or Space.
